description: Get TrustScore details and quality assessment for one or more products: score rationale/commentary, certifications, testing and verified lab results, brand manufacturing/testing practices, and excipient risk ratings. Accepts product ids/slugs/names (multiple). Call this before discussing why a product is (or is not) trustworthy, its certifications, or its testing — the other product tools return only the headline score number.

products.description: One or more product identifiers (max 5): an array of strings, or one string separated by ' | '. Each can be a UUID, slug, or product name. Prefer the ids you already have from a previous product result.

name: suppco_get_product_trust_score
title: Get product TrustScore
